tools.name: schedule_task
tools.description: Schedule a one-shot or recurring task. The user's timezone is declared in the <context timezone="..."/> header of your prompt — interpret the user's "9pm" etc. in that zone. Cron expressions are interpreted in the user's timezone too.

processAfter.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for the first run. Accepts either UTC (ending in "Z" or "+00:00") or a naive local timestamp (no offset) which is interpreted in the user's timezone (e.g. "2026-01-15T21:00:00" = 9pm user-local). Prefer naive local.

recurrence.description: Cron expression for recurring tasks (e.g., "0 9 * * 1-5" = weekdays at 9am user-local). Evaluated in the user's timezone.

script.description: Optional pre-agent script to run before processing

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List scheduled tasks. Returns one row per series — the live (pending or paused) occurrence. The id shown is the series id, which is what update_task / cancel_task / pause_task / resume_task expect.

status.description: Filter by status: pending or paused (default: both)

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update a scheduled task. Pass the series id from list_tasks. Any field omitted is left unchanged. Use this instead of cancel + reschedule when adjusting an existing task.

taskId.description: Series id of the task to update (as shown by list_tasks)

recurrence.description: New cron expression (optional). Pass empty string to clear and make the task one-shot.

processAfter.description: New ISO 8601 timestamp for the next run (optional). Accepts either UTC (ending in "Z" / "+00:00") or a naive local timestamp interpreted in the user's timezone.

script.description: New pre-agent script (optional). Pass empty string to clear.

tools.name: pause_task
tools.description: Pause a scheduled task. It will not run until resumed.
